title: Region selection + tier routing with hosted overflow safety layer
creator: Priya Malik
description:
Goal: implement a resilient routing policy that chooses region and tier for tenant requests while providing a controlled, observable hosted overflow path when dedicated capacity is constrained. This ticket scopes the routing policy design, safety thresholds, orchestrator integration points, rollout plan, and tests.

Background: several incidents showed noisy tenants exhausting dedicated pools in a region and causing latency SLO violations for other tenants. We have existing capacity-aware routing primitives and hosted fallback, but lack a single policy that: (1) robustly prefers tenant-assigned dedicated lanes, (2) gracefully drains/permissions overflow to hosted with cost/quality-aware model variant demotion, and (3) exposes clear telemetry and circuit-breakers for operators.

Scope: implement new routing decision module in the orchestrator that evaluates region affinity, tenant tier, current dedicated pool health, and model-variant compatibility. Add 3 safety knobs: soft-reserve window, probabilistic overflow sampling for canary, and hard circuit-breaker when P50/P95 latency or error budget triggers. Integrate with console dashboards and rollout automation.

Out of scope: autoscaler tuning, billing changes for hosted charges, per-tenant pricing model changes.
acceptance_criteria: Routing module selects tenant-preferred region and dedicated tier by default when pool health is above configured thresholds
When dedicated capacity is saturated or latency SLO threatened, routing shifts traffic to hosted overflow according to soft-reserve and probabilistic-sampling policies
Hosted overflow path applies model-variant demotion chain (full precision -> quantized -> smaller model) with configuration for max demotion depth per tenant
Circuit-breakers trip and route back to queued/backpressure when hosted latency or error exceeds safety limits, and operators receive alerts with runbook link
Console surfaces per-tenant and per-route metrics: dedicated fill, hosted overflow rate, demotion events, latency percentiles, and cost delta estimates
Automated canary rollout: 1% traffic sample -> 10% -> 100% with automated rollback on regression within 24h
tasks: Design spec: finalize decision tree and safety knobs (Priya) - link in 'links'
Orchestrator: add region-tier routing component and policy evaluator (Ethan)
Runtime: expose pool health and per-tenant reservation state to orchestrator (Infra)
Runtime: implement model-variant mapping and demotion API compatible with hosted runtime (Runtime team)
Console: dashboard + alerting for overflow detection and demotion telemetry (DX)
E2E tests: simulated tenant bursts, regional outage, and degrade-to-hosted scenarios with chaos harness (QA)
Runbook: operator steps for manual intervention and escalation (Ops)
Canary plan and rollout automation in CI/CD with rollback hooks (SRE)
